title: One shared CLI value-flag reader; free-text flags accept leading --
body: Retro of t-1j0g4k1 (#340): the same 'value.startsWith("--") means missing' shape remains in src/flow/cli.ts:34, src/evals/cli.ts:77, src/evals/session.ts:77, src/worker/cli.ts:132 and src/cli/ledger.ts:29. Acceptance: one shared reader treats only an absent argument as missing for free-text flags, each CLI uses it, and a rule test rejects new startsWith('--') missing-value checks in src.
